(C) CI publishes: `gh release view v0.1.6` lists boardctl_darwin_amd64, boardctl_darwin_arm64, boardctl_freebsd_amd64, boardctl_linux_amd64, boardctl_linux_arm, boardctl_linux_arm64, boardctl_windows_amd64.exe + SHA256SUMS, author github-actions[bot]; Multi-Arch run 35435110524 shows 'multiarch / Release in 26s' success. (D) DOWNLOADED asset: `curl .../v0.1.6/boardctl_linux_amd64` then `sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS` => 'boardctl_linux_amd64: OK' exit 0; `./boardctl_linux_amd64 version` => 'boardctl version v0.1.6' exit 0; `version --json` => {"version":"v0.1.6","build":"v0.1.6"}; `go version -m` => mod v0.1.6, vcs.revision=9f437bc614c94aa9812168be61a2761941c7cd4d (the tag commit), vcs.modified=false. (E) Duplicate gate: with the downloaded v0.1.6 asset, create QA-TEST-1 then QA-TEST-2 (same title+reasoning) => 'DUPLICATE-SUPPRESSED: QA-TEST-1 matches fingerprint b7f4fac...' exit 2; the downloaded v0.1.5 asset (boardctl-linux-amd64) on the same sequence => 'created task QA-TEST-2' exit 0, confirming v0.1.5 accepted it. (F) Gates all green, run fresh: `go build ./...` exit 0, `go vet ./...` exit 0, `go test -count=1 ./...` exit 0 (ok cmd/boardctl, internal/board, internal/fmtcheck, internal/render, internal/versioncheck, internal/vulncheck), `make fmt-check` exit 0, `make version-check` exit 0, `make vuln-check` exit 0. (G) CI green on pushed commits: `gh run list` shows CI (35435108890) and Multi-Arch (35435109427) both 'completed success' on 9f437bc main push, and Multi-Arch (35435110524) success on the v0.1.6 tag push. (H) dedupe-board acquisition path: README.md:270 documents `go install github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl/cmd/dedupe-board@latest`; verified working via `go install .../cmd/dedupe-board@v0.1.6` (exit 0) and the resulting binary runs a dry-run report. Note: the local dist/boardctl_linux_amd64 reports v0.1.5 — that is the stale pre-tag local build documented in the commit message; the PUBLISHED asset, which is what the criterion specifies, reports v0.1.6.
